parts.name: Battery
parts.description: A 12 V battery. Its location on the bike is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A, so no 3D geometry is drawn.
parts.function: Powers the starter motor and runs the electrical system when the engine is off. The generator recharges it while riding.

oem.note: From 2026 Rebel 500 ABS (CMX500AAC) diagram F820450, read via search index. Listed as GTZ8V type, superseding 31500-KZZ-J11. Confirm on the linked fiche before ordering.

parts.name: Lighting
parts.description: LED headlight, turn signals and taillight.
parts.function: Lets the rider see and be seen, and signals the rider's intentions.

facts.label: Lighting
facts.value: LED headlight, turn signals and taillight

parts.name: Headlight (LED)
parts.description: A round LED headlight. The standard model has no headlight cowl; the color-matched cowl is an SE-only feature.

oem.note: Headlight assembly (maker KOITO) on 2026 Rebel 500 ABS (CMX500AAC) diagram F820408, read via search index and corroborated by a second query. Confirm on the linked fiche.

parts.name: Turn Signals (LED)
parts.description: Front and rear LED turn signals.

parts.name: Front Turn Signals
parts.description: The pair of front LED indicators. Their mounting position is representative.

parts.name: Rear Turn Signals
parts.description: The pair of rear LED indicators. Their mounting position is representative.

parts.name: Taillight / License Light
parts.description: An LED taillight and brake light, plus the license plate light.
parts.function: Rear running light and brake light. The license light illuminates the plate.

oem.note: The 2026 taillight part number was not recorded: one candidate number appeared only on Rebel 300 diagrams.

parts.name: LCD Meter
parts.description: A compact round LCD instrument with gear-position indicator and fuel-consumption display. The mounting position shown is representative.
parts.function: Shows speed, gear position, fuel consumption and warning lamps.

facts.label: Display
facts.value: LCD with gear-position indicator and fuel consumption

parts.name: Ignition System
parts.function: Fires each spark plug at the right moment, as calculated by the engine-control electronics from crank position and engine speed.

parts.name: Ignition Coils
parts.description: Coils that step 12 V up to the high voltage that jumps the spark-plug gap.

parts.name: Spark Plugs
parts.verificationNote: Plug type, gap and torque are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A. Consult the owner's manual or service manual 61MLH00.

service.notes: Torque specification not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).

parts.name: Charging System
parts.description: An engine-driven generator plus a regulator/rectifier.
parts.function: Produces electricity while the engine runs, converts it to regulated DC and recharges the battery.

parts.name: Generator (Alternator)
parts.description: A rotor and stator housed under the alternator cover, as the Honda diagram names indicate.
parts.function: Turns some of the crankshaft's rotation into AC electrical power.

parts.name: Regulator / Rectifier
parts.description: An electronic module that converts and regulates the generator output.
parts.function: Converts AC to DC and limits charging voltage to protect the battery.

parts.name: Starter Motor
parts.description: An electric motor for push-button starting. Its location is not yet verified, so no 3D geometry is drawn.
parts.function: Cranks the engine through the starting clutch when you press the start button.
parts.verificationNote: Honda's 2026 spec lists a push-button electric starter. Location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: ECU / PGM-FI Control Unit
parts.description: The engine control electronics for PGM-FI fuel injection and ignition. The unit's location and part number are not yet verified.
parts.function: Reads the engine sensors and controls injection and ignition timing.
parts.verificationNote: PGM-FI is Honda-confirmed. The control unit's location, name and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Wiring Harness
parts.description: The main wire loom connecting every electrical component. Routing is not yet verified, so no geometry is drawn.
parts.function: Distributes power and carries sensor and switch signals.
parts.verificationNote: Electrical routing is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A. Consult service manual 61MLH00 for wiring diagrams.
